fields.name: Lighthouse Summer
fields.summary: Your first summer in Horizon Strait: an old lighthouse library, an end-of-summer festival, and three different farewells (all-ages visual-novel sample; three chapters, two routes, three endings).

tutorial.name: Lighthouse Summer
tutorial.summary: A sample gal route: talk with Lin Wanqing to advance the story. The festival-night confession unlocks only when her affection reaches 40; the ending follows from affection plus that choice.
